title: Approval of Third Amendment to Agreement No. 47758 between the City of
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of Third Amendment to Agreement No. 47758 between the City of
  Los Angeles, acting by and through the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power and Meyers Nave. The Amendment adds $830,000 for an
  aggregate budget of $3,780,000. The scope of legal services and the term of
  the Agreement, commencing on January 11, 2023, and terminating
  January 10, 2028, shall not change.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).
summary: Approve third amendment to legal services agreement with Meyers Nave increasing contract amount by $830,000 to an aggregate budget of $3,780,000.
